In the figure above, lines $p$ and $q$ are parallel. What is the value of $w$?
explanation: Choice C is correct. Since lines $p$ and $q$ are parallel, corresponding angles formed by the intersection of line $m$ with lines $p$ and $q$ are congruent. Therefore, the angle with measure $w ^\circ$ must be the supplement of the angle with measure $73 ^\circ$. The sum of two supplementary angles is $180 ^\circ$, so $w = 180 - 73 = 107$.
